Verified #73323 against the PyPI-installed `apache-airflow-providers-amazon==9.37.0rc1` with Airflow 3.3.2 and Python 3.12.13.

I drove `EmrServerlessDeleteApplicationOperator` through its full deferral lifecycle, resuming each deferral with a success event as the triggerer would. The EMR Serverless client was mocked.

- `deferrable=True`: stop → `delete_stopped_application` → `DeleteApplication` called once → `EmrServerlessDeleteApplicationTrigger` → done.
- `deferrable=True, force_stop=True`: cancel jobs → stop → delete, with `DeleteApplication` called once.
- A stop-trigger error event fails the task without calling `DeleteApplication`.
- Regressions: `deferrable=False` still deletes, and `EmrServerlessStopApplicationOperator` still resumes at `execute_complete` without deleting.

For comparison, on 9.36.0 the deferrable runs finish with zero `DeleteApplication` calls while logging "deleted successfully", which is the #72123 bug. On the RC, #73323 is working as expected.

Tested `apache-airflow-providers-amazon==9.37.0rc1` for [Build deferred AWS hooks from the operator's own settings (#72171)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72171). Works as expected, no regressions found.

Environment: clean virtualenv on Python 3.11, installed from PyPI, `apache-airflow` 3.3.2, `apache-airflow-task-sdk` 1.3.2, `boto3` 1.43.101. No AWS account involved, since everything below is observable before the first API call.

I ran the same checks against `9.36.0` to confirm they actually depend on this change rather than passing either way.

**1. The operator's settings reach the hook the triggerer builds.** Using `BedrockKnowledgeBaseActiveSensor` in deferrable mode with `region_name="eu-west-3"`, `verify=False` and `botocore_config=Config(read_timeout=77, retries={"max_attempts": 9})`, I captured the `TaskDeferred` and built the hook from the trigger it carried.

| | 9.36.0 | 9.37.0rc1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `region_name` on the trigger | absent | `eu-west-3` |
| `verify` on the trigger | absent | `False` |
| `botocore_config` on the trigger | absent | passed through |

# Apache Airflow 開源貢獻紀錄 by Eason09053360（2026-02 ～ 2026-10-16）

- GitHub：[@Eason09053360](https://github.com/Eason09053360)
- 專案：[apache/airflow](https://github.com/apache/airflow)
- Slack：https://opensource4you.slack.com/team/U0BQPAPCQ57
- 日期：2026 年 2 月 ~ 2026 年 10 月

## 總覽：2026 年 2 月 – 10 月（截至 10/16）

**Summary**

- PR: apache/airflow merged 56 個（[清單](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3AEason09053360+is%3Amerged)）+ 4 個 open
  - 其中 22 個被 backport 到 release 分支（`v3-3-test` 14、`airflow-ctl/v0-1-test` 6、`chart/v1-2x-test` 2）
- Code Review: 24（[清單](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pulls?q=is%3Apr+reviewed-by%3AEason09053360+-author%3AEason09053360)）
- Issue Triage / RC Testing: 7

### Merged PR 分類（依區域）

| 分類 | 數量 |
| --- | --- |
| airflow CLI（`airflow ...`、`DAG.cli()`、`standalone`） | 21 |
| Providers（fab、edge、celery、google、cncf-kubernetes 等） | 17 |
| airflowctl | 7 |
| API server | 4 |
| Task SDK / Triggerer | 4 |
| Helm chart | 2 |
| UI（E2E 測試） | 1 |

主攻是 **Airflow 3 遷移後留下的 CLI / airflowctl / API 正確性問題**，大多是「靜默出錯」型的 bug：exit 0 但結果是錯的、資料被默默改掉、操作其實成功但 CLI 噴 traceback等等。

---

## October 2026（截至 10/16）

**Summary**

- PR: 3 merged + 2 open
- Code Review: 10
- Issue Triage: 1

### PR（merged）

#### Task SDK

- [Fix dateless dag.test and tasks test destroying unrelated Dag runs (#73813)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73813)：`Bug 修正`
  - `dag.test()` / `airflow tasks test` 不帶日期時，會刪掉使用者從 UI 觸發的 Dag run
  - Airflow 3 的手動 / asset 觸發 run 沒有 logical date（`NULL`），但 `get_or_create_dagrun` 用 `==` 查詢，SQLAlchemy 會產生 `IS NULL`，於是刪掉任意一個 dateless run，連帶 cascade 刪掉 task instances
  - `DAG.test()` 的 `clear_dags` 拿 `None` 當上下界，兩個條件都被丟掉，變成清掉這個 Dag **所有** run 的 TI

#### airflow CLI

- [Fix CLI --bundle-name finding no Dags in Git bundles (#73377)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73377)：`Bug 修正`
  - 4 個 CLI 呼叫點沒有先 `bundle.initialize()`（Git bundle 靠它 clone repo），`dags list --local --bundle-name X` 回傳空清單卻 exit 0、`list-import-errors` 回報「沒有錯誤」
  - `tasks test` / `dags test` / `tasks clear` 則退回掃描所有 bundle，可能拿到**另一個 bundle 裡同名的 Dag**
  - [#53699](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/53699) 只修了當時被回報的那一處，這次把其餘呼叫點一起補齊

#### airflowctl

- [Fix airflowctl pools export/import dropping pool team ownership (#73132)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73132)：`Bug 修正` `backport: airflow-ctl/v0-1-test`
  - `airflowctl pools export` → `import --action-on-existing-key overwrite` 會清掉 pool 的 team 歸屬，而且回報成功
  - multi-team 部署用 `team_name` 決定誰能用這個 pool；export 沒寫出這個欄位，bulk 請求又把缺少的欄位序列化成 `"team_name": null` 覆寫回去
  - 舊的 `airflow pools export / import` 本來就有處理，只有照著 deprecation 提示遷移到 airflowctl 的使用者會中招

### PR（open）

#### API server

- [Stop the JWT revocation check stalling the API server event loop (#74364)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74364)：`Bug 修正`
  - JWT revocation 檢查在 event loop 上做同步 DB 查詢，UI polling、worker heartbeat、airflowctl 全部排在後面，connection pool 滿了就逐一 timeout

#### Dag processing

- [Fix sync-perm applying permissions from every stored Dag version (#74360)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74360)：`Bug 修正`
  - `airflow sync-perm --include-dags` 對每個 Dag 依每個版本各 sync 一次且無排序，已撤銷的 role 權限可能被舊版本重新授予

### Code Review

- [Add --asset-ids filtering to db clean (#74498)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74498)
  - `db clean --asset-ids` 會連同 `asset_dag_run_queue` 刪掉還在排隊的舊 asset event，排程在 `a & b` 上的 Dag 等到 `b` 來了也不會跑
  - 指出 [#74495](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74495) 對同樣情境預設是拒絕（409），建議比照處理
- [Snowflake oauth2 password (fork repository fix) (#74804)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74804)
  - `grant_type` 只在 extra 有 `grant_type` 或 `refresh_token` 時才設定，兩者都沒有的既有 OAuth 連線會從原本的明確錯誤訊息變成 `KeyError: 'grant_type'`
  - `get_oauth_token(grant_type="client_credentials")` 也會一起壞
- [Chart: Bump PgBouncer to 1.25.2 and exporter to 0.21.0 to fix CVEs (#74647)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74647)
  - 指出 PgBouncer 1.25.2 仍有 1.26.x 才修掉的未認證 CVE，請作者在 PR 描述註明
- [Fix Cloud Composer system test external task sensors (#74786)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74786)
  - 本地驗證後 approve
  - 另外指出範例裡的 `datetime.now()` 是本地時間卻帶 `Z` 後綴送給 API，在 UTC-7 的 worker 上時間窗會早 7 小時、抓不到剛觸發的 run，而這段是會被使用者照抄的文件範例
- [Recover the revoked-token check from a stale DB connection (fixes idle-timeout 500) (#71444)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/71444)
  - 指出 FAB 3.7.0（[#68100](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/68100)）之後 `deserialize_user` 已會關閉 session，請作者確認 issue 在新版是否仍能重現
- Approve：[#74778](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74778)（本地驗證）, [#74645](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74645), [#74816](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74816), [#74243](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74243)
- 其他：[#74015](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74015)

### Issue Triage

- [AIP-44 Migrate DagModel.deactivate_deleted_dags to Internal API (#29533)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/29533)
  - 2023 年的 issue 一直沒關：查出實際已由 [#29534](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/29534) 完成（2.6.0 釋出），GitHub 只自動關了 `closes` 寫到的 #29532
  - AIP-44 Internal API 也已在 3.0.0 整個移除（[#44502](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/44502)、[#44549](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/44549)），建議關閉

---

## September 2026

**Summary**

- PR: 29 merged + 2 open
- Code Review: 14
- Issue Triage / RC Testing: 3

### PR（merged）

#### airflow CLI

- [Prevent Dag CLI subcommands from being silently dropped (#72340)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72340)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
  - `DAG.cli()`（`python my_dag.py ...`）用過期的 command name 挑 subcommand，讓 `dags backfill`、`tasks run` 靜默消失
  - `args` 用 generator 只能走一次，parser 重建後 `dags pause` 參數從 6 個掉到 2 個
- [Fix DAG.cli() crashing on dags pause and unpause (#72109)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72109)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
  - `python my_dag.py dags pause / unpause` 直接 `TypeError`
- [Fix DAG.cli() crashing on dags test --show-dagrun (#72810)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72810)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Stop airflow standalone leaking components when one fails to start (#72464)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72464)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
  - 一個元件啟動失敗時，shutdown loop 第一個 `stop()` 就丟例外，其餘三個元件在 standalone 結束後繼續連著 metadata DB 跑
- [Fix airflow standalone announcing readiness before the API server is up (#73025)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73025)：`Bug 修正`
  - 「Airflow is ready」在 API server 還沒 bind port 前就印出
  - 追到是 [#46942](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/46942) 刪 webserver 時把 port 檢查一起弄丟
- [Stop airflow providers get --full mutating cached provider metadata (#72346)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72346)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Trace the dag-processor job instead of its parent process with memray (#72367)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72367)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Fix airflow info --file-io uploading an empty report (#72707)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72707)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Allow airflow jobs check --allow-multiple with --limit 0 (#72677)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72677)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Reject non-numeric --limit values in airflow dags list-jobs (#72891)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72891)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
- [Fix airflow dags list --columns help showing wrong default columns (#72607)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72607)：`Bug 修正`
- [Remove ignored --output flag from airflow pools set and delete (#72833)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72833)：`Bug 修正`
- [Fix airflow teams list --output json printing prose when no teams exist (#72945)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72945)：`Bug 修正`
- [Mask the SQLite database path in airflow info --anonymize (#73179)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73179)：`Bug 修正`
- [Fix airflow db check reporting one fewer retry than it will make (#72708)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72708)：`Bug 修正`

#### airflowctl

- [Fix airflowctl backfill pause/unpause/cancel always failing with 405 (#73282)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73282)：`Bug 修正` `backport: airflow-ctl/v0-1-test`
  - `airflowctl backfill pause / unpause / cancel` 從來沒有成功過：server 是 `PUT`、client 送 `POST`，永遠 405；operator 無法從 CLI 停掉失控的 backfill
  - 一直沒被發現是因為測試用的 `httpx.MockTransport` 沒有 route table，任何 method 都回 200 → 補上 method assertion
- [Fix airflowctl commands crashing instead of printing their result (#72675)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72675)：`Bug 修正` `backport: airflow-ctl/v0-1-test`
  - 5 個自動產生的指令在 server 端已經執行成功後才 crash
  - `--output` 只宣告給 10 個 CRUD 動詞，其他指令（`connections test`、`assets materialize`、`backfill *`）在印結果時 `AttributeError`
- [Fix a bad retry env var taking down the whole airflowctl CLI (#72429)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72429)：`Bug 修正` `backport: airflow-ctl/v0-1-test`
  - module scope 的 `int()` 在 import 時就炸，一個寫錯的環境變數讓整個 airflowctl 無法啟動；負數的 wait 更糟，會在隨機一部分 retry 時才從 tenacity 丟例外
  - warning 刻意寫到 stderr 而不是 logger，避免汙染 `-o json > file` 的輸出
- [Fix airflowctl tracebacks on redirects and non-JSON error bodies (#73307)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73307)：`Bug 修正` `backport: airflow-ctl/v0-1-test`
  - 遇到 SSO proxy redirect / ingress HTML 錯誤頁時，從 traceback 改成一行可行動的錯誤訊息
- [Fix airflowctl connections test failing on stored connections (#73098)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73098)：`Bug 修正` `backport: airflow-ctl/v0-1-test`
- [Make airflowctl command generation safe to read more than once (#73097)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73097)：`Bug 修正`

#### API server

- [Fix bulk endpoints returning 500 for a malformed action entry (#73453)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73453)：`Bug 修正` `backport: v3-3-test`
  - 5 個 bulk endpoint（variables / pools / connections / Dag runs / TIs）對格式錯誤的 action 回 500
  - pydantic 的 callable `Discriminator` 拿到未驗證的原始輸入且不包例外 → 改為回 422 並列出可接受的 tag
- [API: Fix prefix pattern search returning rows without the prefix (#73520)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73520)：`Bug 修正`
  - prefix 最後一字是 `9` / `z` / `Z` 時上界會退回較短的 prefix，搜 `dag_9` 會拿到 `dag_abc`

#### Providers

- [Fix airflow roles import crash on a role without permissions (#72796)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72796)：`Bug 修正`（fab）
- [Fix invalid command path in permissions-cleanup help examples (#73028)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73028)：`Bug 修正`（fab）
- [Fix airflow celery stop crashing on stale PID file (#72817)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72817)：`Bug 修正`（celery）
- [Fix airflow edge list-workers always showing null concurrency (#72959)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72959)：`Bug 修正`（edge）

#### Helm chart

- [Fix StatsD not restarting when overrideMappings or cache.ttl changes (#72633)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72633)：`Bug 修正` `backport: chart/v1-2x-test`
  - StatsD 改 `overrideMappings` 或 `cache.ttl` 後 pod 不會重啟，ConfigMap 變了但設定沒生效
- [Helm: Point flower extraNetworkPolicies deprecation at the real key (#72052)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72052)：`Bug 修正` `backport: chart/v1-2x-test`

### PR（open）

- [Batch Team lookups when syncing Dag bundles to the database (#73154)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73154)：`效能`
  - Dag processor 啟動時 `team` 查詢 N+1 → 批次化
- [Fix scheduler refusing to start when [scheduler] only_idle is enabled (#73141)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73141)：`Bug 修正`
  - 開啟文件上的 `[scheduler] only_idle` 會讓 scheduler 直接起不來：`--only-idle` 的預設值在 import 時就從 config 讀，guard 分不出是使用者打的還是 config 給的
  - 一旦 config 開了，command line 也關不掉，跟一般「command line 蓋過 config」的優先順序相反

### Code Review

- [Fix stale DAGs affecting source authorization (#73292)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73292)
  - 指出權限檢查漏洞：當請求的 Dag 本身也是 stale（檔案已刪），過濾後 `file_dag_ids` 為空、檢查被跳過，只能讀這一個 Dag 的人可以拿到整個檔案的原始碼
- [Stop swallowing unexpected keyring errors when saving airflowctl credentials (#70991)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/70991)（merged）
  - 拿掉 handler 後 `None` token 會直接進 keyring，三個平台行為各不同：`keyrings.alt` 丟 `TypeError`、macOS 丟 `PasswordSetError`、Windows 默默存入字串 `"None"`
- [Ensure explicit UTF-8 encoding in prek scripts for Windows compatibility (#73679)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73679)
  - 讀改成 UTF-8 但寫仍用 locale encoding，在 Windows 上反而更糟：`pyproject.toml` 的 `—` 變成非法 byte `0x97`，`AGENTS.md` 的 `→` 直接 `UnicodeEncodeError`
- [Mask sensitive values in airflow config update dry-run output (#73265)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73265)
  - 用 Airflow 2 風格的 `airflow.cfg` 實測，`smtp_password` 等舊版敏感欄位在 dry-run 仍明文輸出
- [Fix airflow variables import exiting 0 even when imports fail (#72958)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72958)
  - `pytest.raises(match=)` 是 `re.search`，舊訊息也會 match，revert 修正後這個 assertion 仍然通過
- [Report missing required API fields in airflowctl CLI (#73317)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73317)
  - Pydantic 的 required 不等於 non-nullable，argparse 只該強制 required 且 non-nullable 的欄位
- [API: Translate domain ValueError in Task State Store route (#73753)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73753)
  - 建議 `autospec=True` 讓測試能抓到參數名稱打錯；並指出 PR 描述的 500 情境實際上會先被 404 擋掉
- 找出重複的 PR：[#73759](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73759), [#73771](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73771)（包含一個被 open PR 上限清掉、但根因分析更完整的 [#72919](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72919)）
- 驗證 revert 修正後新測試會 fail：[#72920](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72920)
- Approve：[#72859](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72859), [#73606](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73606), [#73939](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73939)
- 其他：[#69645](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/69645)

### Issue Triage / RC Testing

- [Status of testing of Apache Airflow 3.3.2rc1 (#73089)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/73089)
  - 在官方 Docker image 上裝 PyPI 的 RC，用 3.3.1 當對照組，自己的 11 個 backport 全部逐項驗證
- [Status of testing Providers that were prepared on September 22, 2026 (#73658)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/73658)
  - 驗證 celery / edge3 / fab 共 4 項，用前一版當對照組
